newsitem.title: USA: Wash state Gov. appoints three key cabinet members.
newsitem.headline: Wash state Gov. appoints three key cabinet members.

text.p: Washington Gov. Gary Locke announced three key cabinet appointments to lead the state's trade, revenue and employment security departments.
Locke named Tim Douglas, long-time mayor of Bellingham, the new director of Community Trade and Economic Development.

He appointed Boeing Co executive Carver Gayton as the commissioner of Employment Security, and Frederick Kiga, a manager of economic and financial consulting at Arthur Anderson, to head the Department of Revenue.
